3.speaker: Hugo Toras
3.text: "Your Majesty. I know I'm old and stuck in my ways. But trust me when I tell you this decree is a mistake."

7.speaker: Hugo Toras
7.text: "You've already dismantled our state religion. Now you want to take an axe to the laws of Nur and nature?"

8.speaker: Hugo Toras
8.text: "It is firmly enshrined in our state religion that same-sex relations are in defiance of the laws of both Nur and nature."

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "Homosexuals aren't freaks. They're people like you and me. Perhaps they're even living right under your nose."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: His eyes narrowed in suspicion. He shook his head.

14.speaker: Hugo Toras
14.text: "Be that as it may, the majority of Rizians do not want this law to change. They wish to see our traditional values preserved."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Look at my reign so far, Hugo. Am I a king who gives a damn about tradition?"

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Tradition is important to me as well. But not when maintaining it leads to people suffering."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "I don't understand. It's not as if I'm proposing a ban on heterosexuality. This decree will help thousands while hurting no one."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "*If* Nur exists, He would want His creations to practice love and tolerance, not hate and bigotry."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "The Nur I worship smiles upon all forms of love. He would not want His creations to practice hate and bigotry."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Homosexuals are deviants, yes. But they deserve re-education, not prison."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Innocent people are dying because of this law. It's my moral imperative to get rid of it."

31.speaker: Hugo Toras
31.text: "The Montalvo affair... yes, tragic. I read about it as well."

32.speaker: Hugo Toras
32.text: "But the man was killed by a rogue prison guard. Not our laws."

33.speaker: Hugo Toras
33.text: "Watch your words, my nephew. The majority of Rizians wish to preserve our traditional values. Does that make them hateful or bigoted?"

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "It does. They must fix their hearts or die."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "It makes them misguided. Over time, they'll come to accept homosexuality, just as Queen Lyza led them to accept women in the workforce."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "They don't really believe that homosexuality is a sin. They've been brainwashed by the Sanctuary."

40.speaker: Hugo Toras
40.text: "The majority of Rizians want the law to stay as it is. Not out of a desire to punish homosexuals, but because they wish to preserve our traditional values."

41.speaker: Hugo Toras
41.text: "No, and your authority as monarch has suffered for it. There is a limit to the amount of radical change our kingdom will tolerate."

42.speaker: Hugo Toras
42.text: "This is not only about what the Royal Houses will think. Your authority as monarch is at stake."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "Are you sure that's what they want? What if they've just been afraid to speak out for all this time?"

44.speaker: Hugo Toras
44.text: "And how long will they tolerate being ruled by a King who views them that way?"

45.speaker: Hugo Toras
45.text: "Your grandmother was a great reformer. But even she would not go this far."

46.speaker: Hugo Toras
46.text: "And how long will they tolerate being ruled by a King who sees their cherished religion as 'brainwashing'?"

47.speaker: Hugo Toras
47.text: "The repercussions of disregarding it will be even worse."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "I want homosexuals in our kingdom to live without fear of oppression."

49.speaker: Hugo Toras
49.text: "Your authority as monarch is slipping. You're losing the people's respect -- and once that's lost, so is your power over them."

53.speaker: Hugo Toras
53.text: "Despite your efforts, your subjects hold fast to their faith. Some may tolerate homosexuality. But nobody is clamoring for its legalization."

57.speaker: Hugo Toras
57.text: "Most of your subjects are Wruhecists who hold fast to their faith. Some may tolerate homosexuality. But nobody is clamoring for its legalization."

58.speaker: Hugo Toras
58.text: "Except Golcondists, of course. But you shouldn't betray the tenets of Wruhecism on *their* behalf."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "I have... close friends in the homosexual community. I want them to live without fear."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "I want to build a more enlightened and just society. If even one Rizian goes to jail simply for loving the wrong person, I have failed at that goal."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "It's all part of my geopolitical strategy. I'm looking to improve relations with Derdia."

68.speaker: Hugo Toras
68.text: "So you would throw away your other priorities as king to make your 'friends' happy."

69.speaker: Hugo Toras
69.text: "So you would throw away your other priorities as king to appease a small minority."

70.speaker: Hugo Toras
70.text: "You cannot enlighten society with the stroke of a pen, Romus. They will resist your attempt to force progressivism on them."

71.speaker: Hugo Toras
71.text: "This is your decision to make. But I warn you that legalizing homosexuality will not calm the unrest on the streets."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "I don't need to justify my decision to you. My mind is made up."

73.speaker: Hugo Toras
73.text: "I understand the importance of diplomacy, Your Majesty, but it shouldn't come at the cost of upending society in one's own country."

77.speaker: Hugo Toras
77.text: "You must take care, Your Majesty. It's not only the Royal Houses who will disapprove of this move."

81.speaker: Hugo Toras
81.text: "You must be more careful, Your Majesty. Your authority as monarch is already slipping."

82.speaker: Hugo Toras
82.text: "Let me ask you this. What exactly are you trying to accomplish by signing this decree?"

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Persecuting homosexuals isn't just morally wrong, it's bad for our global image. I'm trying to bring our values in line with those of the rest of the world."

86.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
86.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCSetup.CurrentTurn"] > 7)) == false

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "That's rich, coming from someone who wanted my daughter to enter into an incestuous marriage."

88.speaker: Hugo Toras
88.text: "Whether or not you personally approve of it, marriage between cousins is a well-established royal tradition. And one that has no impact on the larger populace."

89.speaker: Hugo Toras
89.text: "Most Rizians wouldn't bat an eye if Her Highness married Rico. But if their children saw their two male neighbors holding hands in public, they'd perceive it as an attack on their values."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "That's rich, coming from someone who wants my daughter to enter into an incestuous marriage."
90.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCSetup.CurrentTurn"] > 7)) == false

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "And you don't think that's a problem?"

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "Yes, because the Sanctuary has brainwashed them into feeling that way."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "You don't know that. Maybe Rizians are more supportive of homosexuality than you think."

97.speaker: Hugo Toras
97.text: "And by 'the rest of the world', you mean ATO."

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: He folded his arms with a frown.

99.speaker: Hugo Toras
99.text: "It isn't enough for Arcasia and its cronies to undermine the world's last existing monarchies. They must claim they're doing so out of moral superiority..."

103.speaker: Hugo Toras
103.text: "This is your decision to make. But if you're trying to unite the kingdom behind your reforms, I'd advise you to steer clear of such a divisive act."
103.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true)

110.speaker: Hugo Toras
110.text: "This is your decision to make. But I warn you that passing such a frivolous act in the midst of a war will win you no favors. With House Toras or anyone else."
110.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

111.speaker: Hugo Toras
111.text: "This is your decision to make. But I warn you that passing such a frivolous act while ordinary citizens go hungry will win you no favors."
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: He bowed and left the room.

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: Hugo lifted it off the table by its corner, as if the paper itself were poisonous.

116.speaker: Hugo Toras
116.text: "I'll see to it that this gets enacted."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Have it your way, Your Grace. The law shall stay as it is for now."

118.speaker: Hugo Toras
118.text: "From the bottom of my heart, I thank you."

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: He lifted the unsigned decree by its corner, as if the paper itself were poisonous.

120.speaker: Hugo Toras
120.text: "I am merely telling you how it is. If you believe your subjects will support you in this, you are mistaken."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "It's not frivolous to me. You're on the wrong side of history."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "There's nothing 'divisive' about it to me. You're on the wrong side of history."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "That doesn't matter. History will vindicate me."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "You wouldn't think that way if you were homosexual yourself. Can't you empathize with them?"

128.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
128.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)

129.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
129.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)) == false

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: He shot me a sharp glance.
130.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "I know I'm taking a risk. But nothing is more important to me than achieving equal rights for all citizens."

132.speaker: Hugo Toras
132.text: "This is your decision to make. But I advise you to think carefully about whether your reign can weather the repercussions of such an act."
132.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

133.speaker: Hugo Toras
133.text: "If I were unfortunate enough to be burdened with such desires, I would have the good sense to keep them to myself."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "You've made your point, Hugo. I need to think about this."

137.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
137.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)

138.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
138.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)) == false

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: He shot me a sharp glance.
139.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)

140.speaker: Hugo Toras
140.text: "You care about this topic more than I realized, Your Majesty."

141.speaker: Hugo Toras
141.text: "I had no idea this topic meant so much to you, Your Majesty."
141.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)) == false

142.speaker: Narrator
142.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false)) == false

144.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
144.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Enemy"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] > 2  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false

145.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
145.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Enemy"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] > 2  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false) == false

146.speaker: Hugo Toras
146.text: "I'll be honest. If ever there were a time to pass this decree, it would be now, while you're still in good standing."
146.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Enemy"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] > 2  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false

147.speaker: Hugo Toras
147.text: "I will be honest. Decriminalizing homosexuality may be seen as 'progress' in foreign circles. But here in Rizia, it will damage your standing beyond repair."
147.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 7  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseToras_Friendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseAzaro_Enemy"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] > 2  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false) == false

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "You're my Grand Vizier. What do you think the repercussions will be?"

149.speaker: Hugo Toras
149.text: "But as a practicing Wruhecist and a member of House Toras, I cannot and will not endorse it."

150.speaker: Hugo Toras
150.text: "And if passing it leads to your downfall, whoever leads Rizia in your stead will surely reverse it. Leaving homosexuals no better off than before."

151.speaker: Hugo Toras
151.text: "So please, think carefully. Is this truly what you want for the kingdom?"

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: I took one more look at the document in front of me.

153.speaker: Hugo Toras
153.text: "I'll file this away safely for now."
